dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yong pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes — 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad shar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin——legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//spung 'i bod rig pa dpe na khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyisanas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung 1

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tsha ni rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam bto ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang /deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ོ du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang /dgon sdodang /spyi tsho gis kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhugate/rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nasagazigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang /mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing /lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes wo du masang tsho'i las kar gdeng 'jog ra med dang /ma nor lam ston/ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshone/nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang /snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabasaga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang /zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang /slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang /nga tsho'i las kar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o//ser gtsug nang gas dpe〉 'chos ba(phyogs ga khang na /spyi lo 79lo'i zla ba6pa'i tshes7la/

bas sgrig gsal bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos ma yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs snye su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir sa spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / g.yin yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhin bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags zhan 6) rtogana' ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas7bar pod rtags 6) 'a) (ja) snye thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum nye pod rtags la (ja she (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags6) storgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen rba sod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags (tha)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung la jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags 6)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags 6)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags(pha)ste 'dul ba'i

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang /chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/deb 18pa la pod rtags khra)ste bstod tsho gis dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcugacig deb 19nas21bar pod rtags 'a ) ( mi64sto sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (7ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/deb 23pa la pod rtags 6)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma 6)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang /gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su la lja mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du la lha'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang /'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags 2na ba 'di'i nang bkod yod/

zhu dag byed skabs/thog ma'i zhu dag dang /bskyar zhus/yang zhus/zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing /tshig phrad dang /lhag bcas/rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang /tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/mtshams la 'tshams/mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/med la smad/byung la 'byung /rang rkya la rang skya/grwa la gra klong la slong /rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/rig gnas la rigs gnas/rigs pa la rig pa/gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang /nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang /shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad skar ram/yig thogazhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang /pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang /mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o//ser gas khang bod ༷ zloX///zla ba'iX na//

mdzad ba po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyalapo'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhesabya dang / /me tog cesabyar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / g.yin yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hong gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku gzungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' lda na pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdo zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'amang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi cho ge skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis lasaslob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengasamadzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang /dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/chos gzhis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang /de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang /pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang /lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg wo rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang /mdzod la chos mdzo rin li 'dren pa'i shing rta/'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang /rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung /de bzhi rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chagazhal gdams/snyan mgur/snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/lam yigabasko 'ja'/grwa tshang 'don cha/dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod/ gnyis bcas/legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o//sogatso khang da sgo rdzing 'chos ba phyog ga khar /

dkar chagabastan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel rnams gsal bar byed pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs dang po'i tshig don mtha' dpyod/ (1)mar brjod dang rtsom par dam 4'a ba (1)mas gyi don bshad pa/ (4)gzhung gi don las bshad pa la 'jug pa'i bya ba/ (7)bka' dang bstan bcos bshad pa/ (10)bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa las byams gzhung bshad pa/ 517)yum sras bshad pa/ 421)gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs bshad pa/ (27)myang 'das bshad pa/ (37)chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul bshad pa/ (41)'dir bstan yang dag mtha' bshad pa/ 546)dgos sogs chos bzhi bshad pa/ (63)sher phyin bshad pa/ (69)dngos brgyad don bdun cu bshad pa/ 473)rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu rgyas par bshad pa/ (78)1

theg r+ṣa gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed bshad pa/ 478)theg chen gyi gdams ngag bshad pa/ (95)bden pa gnyis kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ (98)'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi bshad pa/ 5103)skyabs gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ 5110)spyan lnga bshad pa/ (120)mngon par shes pa drug bshad pa/ (125)dge bon dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa/ (132)theg wo gyi sbyor lam bshad pa/ (136)shes sgrib ༅ mongs gzung rtog dang rnam byang gzung rtog bshad pa/ (157)yongs 'dzin gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ (167)rang bzhin gnas rigs bshad pa/ 5169)theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa bshad pa/ (179)theg wo sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba bshad pa/ (183)go sgrub bshad pa/ (186)'jug sgrub bshad pa/ 5188)tsho gis sgrub bshad pa/ (190)rtogs dka' ba sa'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa/ (195)gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bshad pa/ (212)nges 'byung sgrub pa bshad pa/ (213)

bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel rnams gsal bar byed pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs gnyis pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod/ (217)lam shes mtsho ni byed kyi chos bcu gcig rgyas par bshad pa/ (217)lam shes kyi yan lag bshad pa/ (220)nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes bshad pa/ (233)nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bshad pa/ (241)rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes bshad pa/ (245)rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bshad pa/ (254)theg chen gyi mthong lam bshad pa/ (255)theg chen gyi sgom lam bshad pa/ (270)mos pa sgom lam bshad pa/ (276)bsngo ba sgom lam bshad pa/ (280)rjes su yi rang ba'i sgom lam bshad pa/ (282)sgrub pa sgom lam bshad pa/ 4284)rnam dag sgom lam bshad pa/ (287)bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel rnams gsal bar byed pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs gsum pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod/ (295)3

gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu rgyas par bshad pa/ (295)bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel rnams gsal bar byed pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs bzhi pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod/ (326)rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig rgyas par bshad pa/ (326)rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i bsgom bya bshad pa/ (327)gzhi shes kyi rnam pa bshad pa/ (330)sgrib gnyis bshad pa/ 5333)lam shes kyi rnam pa bshad pa/ (337)rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bshad pa/ (341)nyan thos la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa bshad pa/ (343)byang chub sems dpa' la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i lam shes kyi rnam pa bshad pa/ (349)thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bshad pa/ (353)sbyor ba'i yon to bshad pa/ 〈365)sbyor ba'i skyon bshad pa/ (368)spyor ba'i mtshan nyid bshad pa/ (370)theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun bshad pa/ 5384) theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun bshad pa/ (389)phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bshad pa/ (394)srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba bshad pa/ (413)

zhing dag sbyor ba bshad pa/ (417)thabs mkhas sbyor ba bshad pa/ (418)bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel rnams gsal bar byed pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs lnga pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod/ (423)rtse sbyor mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad rgyas par bshad pa/ 〈423)sbyor lam rtse sbyor bshad pa/ (424)mthong lam rtse sbyor bshad pa/ (431)sgom lam rtse sbyor bshad pa/ (451)bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor bshad pa/ (4yo)bsal bya 31ga sgrub bshad pa/ (468)bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel rnams gsal bar byed pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs drug pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod/ (473)mthar gyis sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gsum rgyas par bshad pa/ (473)bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel rnams gsal bar byed pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs bdun pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod/ (478)skad cig ma sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi rgyas par bshad pa/ (478)5

bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel rnams gsal bar byed pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs brgyad pa'i tshig don mtha' dpyod/ (486)'bras bu chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi rgyas par bshad pa/ (486)ngo bo nyid sku bshad pa/ (490)ye shes chos sku bshad pa/ (493)longs sku bshad pa/ (509)mchog gi sprul sku bshad pa/ (524)mjug gi don bshad pa/ (536)mdzad byang / (538)

phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ (pa )ra༅༅/ /bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel rnams gsal bar byed pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs dang po'i tshig don mtha' dpyod bzhugs so/ /mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/༄༅/ /phul du byung ba'i mtha' bral bsod nams mchog gi zla ba'i ma ma gang / /bla na med pa'i ye shes sa 'dzin dbang po dag gi zlos gar las/ /(2na〉skyi gsum 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa'i zas gtsang sras po bsil zer can/ /phan dang bde ba'i ut+pal dkar po rab tu rgyas pa'i dge legs stsol/ /(2ba/zhel dkar rdul brtsegs rta ljang dbang po yis/ /lan brgyar 'khyud la sgeg mo'i gzugs ldan na/ /mdzes sdug khyod sku'i dper bstan tshangs sras ma/ /ngag gi dbang phyug thams cad ma sbyin kye/ /(3na skogs par dka' ba'i rgyal yum don/ /legs par ston pa'i sngon med rgyan/ /phyogs 'di shing rta chen po yi/ /mgrin par 'chang mdzad mi pham pa/ /(3bas dman brtson 'grus rdul gyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i dri bsung can/ /dga' ldan ma la ya nas len mdzad pa'i/ /thogs med dpyid kyi pho nya phyag gi yul/ /mtha' yas shes bya'i tshig don rtsal gsum kun/ /yongs rdzogs legs bshad seng ge'i nga ro'i sgras/ /rgol ngan gnyisa'athung skrag pa'i mdzad bzang dpal/ /rnam 'dren nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan la 'jibs/ /mdo rgyan 'grel bar bcas pa'i yid bzhin nor/ /'phags yul rin chen gling nas 'dren mkhas pa'i/ /—1 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo6)'jig rten mig ga skad ban : dpal brtsegs/ blo ldan shes rab sogs/ gnyis smra ba'i drin/ /kun gsal mdzes ma'i mthas kyang gzhal du ci/ /'jam mgon sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar 'chi med dbang po'i dga' ba'i tshal rab yangs pa las/ /gser mngal can sogs rgan po kun gyi snyems pa 'phrog byed med byung blo gros yongs 'du'i ljon/ /mkhas pa'i lhug phran gzhen nu'i phon po ldem ldem rab g.yo btsun pa'i dri bsung ches cher 'phro/ /bzang po'i 'bras bu khur du rab dud grags snyan ro brgya dpyod ldan legs bris 'dod 'jo'i dpyid/ /rna ba brgyad pa'i thod ltar pha mtha' yongs bral rgyal ba'i gsung rab chu klung che/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma skal ldan shing rtas rab drangs legs bshad yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /rnam dpyod hub kyis cig car 'thungs la stobs ldan dar ma rin chen dza ཿsa/ /slar skyugs gsung rab yang snying nor bu'i 'phreng 'di thub bstan lus phra'i rgyan du mtshar/ /rje bo'i stobs dang nor ldan spyod tshul tsam/ /skyabs su bsten min brgya phrag gzhung lugs la/ /brgal brtag dpyad bzod tshul 'di'i (4na tshegs la chos rje legs chos pa/ chos rje bsod nams grags/ chos rje rje gzha pa sogs/ byed can/ /kun la dang ba'i spro ba cis mi 'phel/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i zhal skyon bdud rtsis thugs kyi za ma tog gtams las/ /srid 'dir yongs dkon drang nges 'byed pa'i mkhyen rab gser skyogs kyis bcusapa'i/ /legs bshad zil mngar dga' ston mchog gis shes ldan skabs gsum bde ba yis/ /chosakun 'byed pa'i shes rab 'phel mdzad yongs 'dzin zhabs pad gtsug tu bsnyen/ /e ma zur phud lnga pa gang / /chags bral ngur smrig 'chang ba yi/ /sgyu 'phrul smin ma'i gar mkhan ma/ /mkhas dbang gang de'i bka' drin las/ /lha yi lam ltar pha mtha'i tshad/ /gzhal ba las 'gongs rgyal yum don/ /bdag lta'i dman blo'i lus 'degs kyis/ sang zad spyod pa'i skal ba thob/ /de phyir rgyal dbang btsong kha pa/ /sras bcas dgongs don yongs 'dzin rje'i/ /gsung las thos pa'i tshig gi 'phreng / /blo bzang dgongs rgyan 'di na spro/ /gang zhig mngon sum rjes dpag tshad ma yis/ /gzhal nus gsung rab don la ltar rmongs kyang / /lkog tu gyur sogs chos kun ma lus pa/ /mkhyen par rlom pa gangs can 'di na —2

phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ 9)mang / /mi bsrun bzod dka'i nyon mongs me 'obs dong / /tshul 'chos thal bas g.yogs pa'i snang tshul gyis/ /sgrib byang rgyal ba'i mtshan la bdag gir can/ /mgrin bzang gzig lpags gyon pasabod 'di gang / /kye ma lung rigs smra ba'i 'bab stegs dang / /bral ba'i dregs ldan mtha' dag tshul 'di la/ /rtog dpyod ngal ba spangs te mthon po'i khrir/ /bag (4ba thad gnyid kyi dga' ston lhur byos shig /be+eḍūr+ya mthing kha 'khyil 'dra'i rdzing bu la/ /'khor lo'i yan lag can kun 'du ba ltar/ /theg chen lam 'dir bzang po'i bag chags dag /sad pa'i blo gsal mtha' dag rna ba blogs/ /de ltar legs byas kya dngos po mtha' klas par bskrun pa'i yul khyad par can rnams la ched du brjod pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro 'phang 'gro'i rgyud las nye bar drangs te/ rang cag rnams kyis mjal bar dka' ba sgron me'i bskal pa rnams kyi nang nas/ /lha rnams kyis bstod bsngags kyi 'phreng bsabazang po'i bskal par grags pa 'di la/ /stobs bstomang 'a ba stong gi nang nas/ /snying stobs kyi go cha btsan po ma smad pa gyon pa'i skyes mchog /ma lus par spangs pa/ legs par rtogs pa/ brtse chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid du gyur pa/ snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i sems can blo ma sbyangs pa/ dbang po mtha' dag nyon mongs pa'i phyogs su rtas pa rnams la snying rjes lhag par brlan pa/ ston pa bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/ ches shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i dal ba'i rten bzang bo thob pa'i dus 'dir/ de don ldan du byed pa'i thabs dam pa/ mchog dman gyi 'gro ba'i blo ngo dang 'tshamasapar/ rgyal bas chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams kyi tshig don thos bsam sgom pas gtan la 'bebs pa las ches lhag pa ma mchis la/ khyad par du phra zhing rtogs par dka' ba'i sbasadon mngon rtogs kyi don gsal bar mdzad pa la 'gran zla med pa'i shing rta chen por rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i 'phags pa thogs med kyi bka' srol phyin ci ma log pa (ldan)rjod byed kyi tshig nyung zhing brjod bya'i don tshang bar 'grel nus ba'i slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i ring lugs 'khrul pa dang bral ba/ gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir gsal bar ston pa'i snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba —3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo6)gnyis pa yab sras kyi gsung rab rin po cher/ blo gros kyi bgo skal ci mchis pas skyod pa ni rnyed pa'i mchog yin pa'i phyir na gtan la 'bebs par bya'o/ /mtshan gyi don bshad pa/de la gsum/ mtshan gyi don/ gzhung don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po la/ dngos dang / zhar byung gnyas las/ dang po la/ mtshan bsgyur ba dang / mtshan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du zhesapa nas/ 'grel pa zhes pa'i bar byung / sbyor ngag tu dril na/ shes bya chos can/ rgya gar gyi skad du/ bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la a bhi zhes sogs/ bod yul gyi skad du bsgyur na/ shes rab cesasogs la 'jug pa yin te/ a bhi sam ya mngon par rtogs pa/ a lo ka ra rgyan/ nā ma zhes bya ba/pradzñā shes rab/ pā ra mi ta pha rol tu phyin pa/ u pa de sha man ngag tha sta bstan bcos/ bri ti 'grel par skad shan sbyor rigs pa'i phyir/ des na slob dpon daṇ+ḍi sa/ ngag gi rang bzhin de dag kyang / /legs sbyar de bzhin rang bzhin dang / /zur chag 'dres ma zhes bya ste/ /rnam pa bzhi ru mkhas pasagasungs/ /zhes skad rigs bzhir bshad pa las/ 'di ni legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad de/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab de'i dgongs 'grel tshad ldan phal cher legs sbyar gyi skad du brjod pas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ mkhas pa'i dbang po stag tshang lo tsā bas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab (5ba)thams cad sum dang ni/ /ting gi mtha' can legs sbyar lha yi skad/ /byings dang rnam 'gyur rkyen gyi rang bzhin du/ /gnas phyir 'phags yul mkhas rnams tshul 'dir rol/ /zhes gsungs pa lta ra ro/ /spyir sgra bsgyur ba la/ brgyud de bsgyur ba/ yan lag bsgyur ba/ rnam grangs bsgyur ba/ rang thad bsgyur ba bzhing/ /gnas brgyad chen po'i rtsa ba las gsungs pa'i dang po ni go lu zhes pa'i sgra las brgyud pas/ 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu smin pa ni/ /dri ma med pa'i chu la lhung / /nya yis za ba'i ched du ni/ / gu lu —4

phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ 6)gu lu zhes su smra/ /zhes bsgyur ba lta bus dang / gnyis pa ni/ a pra shi ka zhes pa so sor phral bas/snying dang 'dra ba'i grogs po 'dis/ /dben pa'i gnas su bdag bzung ste/ /rkang pas mgo bo mnan byas nas/ /ral gyis mgo bo nye bar bcad/ /ces bsgyur ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ko shi ka zhes pa brgya byin/ mkhas pa/ gu gul/ 'ug pa/ ku sha thogs pa/ mdzod ldan rnams la 'jug pa skabs thob kyis bsgyur ba lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ de dag las logs su bsgyur ba rnams yin pas 'chad tshul mtha' yas la/ de lta na yang rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung / bod skad du bsgyur ba la dgos pa'i gtso bo ni/ pang lo chen pos/ rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum/ /brda sprod gzhung gi brjod bya yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ byings la rkyen dang / rtags la rnam dbye ster tshul 'di nyid gtso bo yin kyang / skabs 'dir byings sgrub sogs kyi spros pa byas tshe/ phyogs 'di la brda ma byang ba rnams kyis don lta zhog /tshig tsam yang tshul bzhin du brjod par dka' bas mi 'chad la/ skad shan sbyar (6na tha tsam ni gong du sbyong ngag gi skabs su smos zin to/ /de yang lo tsā bas rgya skad smos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rgya gar gyi yul de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams bltams pa dang / 'tshang rgya tshul bstan/ chos gsungs shing mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa rnams bstan cing / ston par 'gyur ba'i yon tan khyad 'phags dang ldan pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung khungs yin pa'i phyir na/ khungs btsun pa'i ched du yin la/ 'ga' zhig rgya gar zhes pa la sgra bshad par byed na'ang / 'di ni 'dod rgyal bar mkhas pa tshad thub phal cher bzhed cing / blo chung la la dag /sgra bshad du med na don rtogs mi nus snyam pa ni blo shin tu dman te/ rnam 'grel las/ grags pa brda yi rjes 'gro can/ /de yang brjod 'dod rjes 'gro can/ tha snyad don du byas pa ste/ sdeb sbyor ming dang sgra cha bzhin/ zhes pa'i tshig tsam yang rna bar ma thos pa'i skyon no/ /mkhas rlom kha cig gis rgya gar gyi yul dbus ma ga dha zhes pa mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po'i me ghas bzung ba'i yul yin pas de ltar grags zhes smra ba ni/ ma ju ga ta dha ra la tsan+d+ra pa'i dgongs pa ltar/ bṛ kho dha ra'i bsdub byas—5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonapa/bod skad du dbus 'gyur 'chang yin pa sogs ma thos pa'i gtam yin zhing /'di 'dra'i rigasakyi brjod bya/bka' brgyud pa rnams kyis nā ro pa'i sgra bshad byed pa lta bu'i blun gtam la bod yul 'dir zad pa med pa'i phyir dgag gzhag gi spros pa bskyungs te dkyus la 'jug par byed do//gnyis pa ni/gdul bya'i shes rgyud nyen mongs pa las 'chos shing /ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i 6ba tha stan bcos ma 'a par rtogs pa'i rgyan chos can/khyod la man ngag ces brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/lam dang 'bras bu sher phyin brjod byar byed pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i don rtogs byed kyi thabs yin pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/rgyan gyi brjod bya mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po chos can/khyod la mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mas yod de/rang yul mngon sum du rtogs pa'am/de la mngon du phyogs pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/bstan bcos 'di chos can/khyod la rgyan zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/mdzes ma rgyan bzang gis spras pa me long du shar ba mthong ba na chags ldan dga' ba ltar/yum la dngos po brgyad don bdun cus spras pa bstan bcos 'dir gsal bar mthong tshe mkhas pa rnams dga' ba'i phyir/shes bya chos can/'di la ces bya ba zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/rgyan gyi ming don de ltar du sgrogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir/'grel pa don gsal chos can/khyod la 'grel pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/rgyan gyi don legs par 'grel bas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/bam grangs dang /'gyur phyag gnyis las/dang po ni/shes bya chos can/bam po dang po zhes brjod pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/bstan bcos 'di la sho lo ka sum brgya re la bam por byas pa'i bam po lnga yod pa'i dang po 'di nas 'dzin pas de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/bstan pa snga dar gyi lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang /phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab gnyis chos can/khyod kyis 'di bsgyur ba'i thog mar gus pa tshul gyis sangs rgyas dang byang 7na tsho sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba la da/sa pa yod de/gnas skabs 'gyur gyi bar chad zhi

phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs la skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bshad sgo / (padazhing /mthar thug byang grol 'thob pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/gzhung gi don las bshad pa la 'jug pa'i bya ba/gnyis pa gzhung don la/bshad pa la 'jug pa/bshad pa nyid dgod pa/bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i tshul gsum las/dang po la/mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba/'grel pa rtsom rigs par sgrub pa/khengs skyung zhing spro ba skyed pa'i rgyu mas no//dang po la/gzhung gi tshig don bshad pa dang /mtha' dpyad ba gnyis las/dang po ni/slob dpon seng bzang chos can/khyod kyi 'grel pa 'di rtsom pa'i thog mar gzhung lam 'bras bu'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal ba yin te/de la gus pas 'dud pa'i phyir/slob dpon gyis 'di rtsom pa'i thog mar sher phyin gsum la phyag sgol ba la chos can/dgos pa yod de/yum de'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa dag/yum gsum po kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur ba ni/'grel pa 'dis rnam par dbye bar bya ba'i phyir du yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/dgag gzhag spang gsum las/dang po ni/kha cig 'grel byed mkhan po g.yin gyi rjes su ma gongs par/mdo don rang dbang du 'grel bar byed pa'i gang zag de shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi mtshan nyid yin zer na/rgyan rtsom pa po'i rje btsun byams mgon chos can/mtshon bya der thal/mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ma grub na/der thal/shing rta'i srol 'byed gzhan gyi rjes su ma 'brangs par mdo don rang dbang du 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan mdzad pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/7bso bar 'dod na/de chos can/dbu ma ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin par thal/theg wo gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed gang zhig/khyod de yin na khyod dbu ma pa'i de yin dgos pa'i phyir/'dod na/mngon rtogs rgyan de dbu ma pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi bstan bcos yin par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/mdo sde rgyan de sems tsam pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi bstan bcos yin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonapar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rje btsun sems tsam pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ dbu ma pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / mchog zung gnyis chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/der thal/ 'grel 'byed gzhan gyi rjes su ma 'brangs par mngon pa'i dgongs pa rang dbang du bkral ba'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig /'grel pa don gsal mdo rgyan sbyar ba'i 'grel pa yin zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ de nyid las/ ngag sogs sbyor ba ma byas par/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ tshig gi cha gtso bor ma sbyar ba'i don yin zer na/ mdo'i don gtan la 'bebs pa'i 'grel pa yin na/ mdo 'grel yin pas khyab par thal/de mdo rgyan sbyar ba'i 'grel pa gang zhig /khyod kyi lung don 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus so/ /kha cig rgyan gyi bshad bya'i mdo yin na/ de'i bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo yin pas khyab zer na/bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ mdo yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyis gsung rab mtha' dag (8na tshe ni don ma tshang ba med par bsdusate gtan la phab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des rigs can gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa'i ngo bo nges pa grangs nges pa go rim nges pa bstan pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ theg dman gyi mdo yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig khri brgyad stong pa dang mdo sdud pa gnyis de'i bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo yin zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ de'i bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo la yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du grangs nges pa'i phyir der thal/ rnam bshad las yum gsum kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur ba ni zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig mdo sdud pa khri brgyad stong pa'i le'u gya bzhi pa yin pa la bsams nas khri brgyad stong pa yin zer na/mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs gnyis pa mngon rtogs rgyan yin par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/'dod na/ de'i brjod bya la dngos brgyad don bdun cu tshang bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus so/ kha cig ti shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ /zhes pa'i rkang pa bzhi po de/ 'grel pa'i mchod brjod —8

par phyin blo bzang dgong rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgro dbyangs las skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ (panadang rtsom par dam bca' gnyis ska'i gzhung yin zer na/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ /gus phyag 'tshal zhes pa 'di 'grel pa'i rtsom par dam bca'i gzhung yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyin/ 'dod na/gzhung de las logs su/ kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur bar ni/ /rnam par dbye phyir/ zhes logs su smos pa la dgos pa med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi po 'dis 'grel pa'i mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' gnyis ka (8ba tha stan te/ drangs ma thag pa'i gzhung snga mas mchod brjod dang / phyi mas rtsom par dam bca' bstan pa'i phyir/ shing rta'i srol 'byed du rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i byang 'phags de shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi mtshan nyid/ shing rta'i srol byed la klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis su grangs nges te/ de gnyis sangs rgyas kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed du lung bstan pa'i phyir dang / legs bshad snying po las/ bde gshegs gsung rab tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol/ /legs par phye bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /sa gsum 'gro na nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa/ /klu sgrub thogs med ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon rtogs kyi rim pa rnams yum gyi mdosasbas don du byed tshul ji ltar na/ spyir de la ma bstan par sbas pa dang / bstan yang mi mngon par sbas pa gnyis las/ 'di ni phyi ma ste/ ma' rtogs brgyad kyi mtshan nyid dang gzhi ldog rnams yum gyi mdos mi mngon pa'i tshul gyis bstan pa'i phyir/ mngon rtogs brgyad kyi rang ldog ni de ltar ma yin te/de dngos su bstan pa'i phyir/der thal/ de dngos su bstan pa'i yum gyi mdo tshig yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa rtsod pa spong ba la/ kha cig khri brgyad stong pa mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo yin par thal/ de dang rgyan sbyar ba'i tshad ldan gyi 'grel pa yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na de chos can/ kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur bar ni/ zhes pa'i rgyan gyi bshad gzhi'i mdo yin par thal/ rgyan gyi bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus so/ kha cig rje btsun shing rta'i srol 'byed yin par thal/ de yin par (9na〉spegs bshad gser 'phreng du gsungs pa'i phyir na/ de ni shing rta'i —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smonasrol 'byed gzhan la ma ltos par dga' ldan du sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gtan la phab pa tsam la dgongs so/ /bka' dang bstan bcos bshad pa/gnyis pa 'grel pa rtsom rigs par sgrub pa la/ phyi'i rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi man ngag dang ldan par sgrub pa/ nang gi rkyen bstan bcos kyi don mtha' dag rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan par sgrub pa/ des na 'grel pa rtsom rigs pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi las/ thogs med kyi man ngag dang ldan tshul la/ gzhung gi tshig don bshad pa dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam pa snying rjes 'gro la chags pas kun tu ste/ lhag par chags par mdzad pa dang / sbyor ba gzhan sdug bsngal las skyob pa nyid kyi 'phags pa thogs med chos can/ khyod kyi sgra bshad du yod pa'i bstan bcosachen po/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam bshad mdzad rigs te/ khyod mi pham mgon po la don 'di rdzogs par gsan nas ni thugs su chud pa'i mkhas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dgag gzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rong ṭīka pa na re/ bstan bcos chen po'i rnam bshad mdzad ces pa'i bstan bcos de/ mngon rtogs rgyan la byed zer na/ nyi khri de nyid rnam nges mdo rgyan sbyar ba'i 'grel pa yin par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi 'thad par thal/ mdo rgyan sbyar ba'i 'grel pa'i thog ma nyi khri snang ba nas 'dzin rigs pa'i phyir/ g.yin yang / dam bca' de mi 'thad par thal/ sher 'byung blo gros kyi 'grel (9ba)par/ thogs med kyis mdo rgyan sbyar ba'i 'grel pa ma mdzad par bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang bstan bcos mtha' dag ma rnyed par zhes pa'i bstan bcosade yang mngon rtogs rgyan la byed rigs par thal/ rtsa ba'i dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/mtha' dag ces mang tshig smos pa la dgos pa med par thal lo /—10

phar phyin blo bzang dgong rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs la skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ (panakha cig /spobs pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i gsung rab bka'i mtshan nyid yin zer na/ 'grel pa don gsal chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ spobs pa bzhi dang ldan pa gang zhig /gsung rab yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ brjod bya don dang ldan/ rjod byed tshig dang 'brel/ gdul bya'i mi mthun phyogs spong phyir du gsungs/ zhi ba myang 'das kyi phan yon ston pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po sangs rgyas 'phags pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /sang ba'i rgyas kyi bka' yin na/ sangs rgyas rang rgyud kyis bsdug pa'i bka' yin pas khyab zer na/ rab 'byor gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i bga' brgyad stong pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bya ba yul la yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab kyi 'phrin las yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bya ba yul la yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las rang yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig /gsung ba po ston pa g.yin gyi rjes su ma gongs par/ gdul bya'i don du rang stobs kyis brtsams pa'i gsung rab de bka'i mtshan nyid zer na/ shā ri'i bu dang spyan ras gzigs gnyis dri ba dri lan byas (10na)pa'i shes rab snying po'i mdo tshig chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal mtshon bya de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ byin gyis brlabasapa'i bka' yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ gnyis ka ston pa'i rjes 'brang yin pa'i phyir/kha cig /'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i gsung rab mthar thug de bstan bcos rnam dag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ 'grel pa don gsal chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gsung rab mthar thug yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ seng bzang gsung ba po mthar thug yin par thal/ don gsal gsung rab mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/khyod las lhag pa'i gsung ba po yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang brgyad stong pa chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ bka' yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i ngag de bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos chos —11 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonacan/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ der thal/ phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir/khyab pa yod de/ phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir/ de'i bstan pa bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ de'i ston pa ston pa yin pa'i phyir/ ston pa yin na lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi ston pa po yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ kha cig /rtsom pa po rnam g.yeng med pa'i sems can gyis bka'i dgongs 'grel du brtsams pa'i ngag rnam dag de/ bka'i dgongs 'grel du gyur pa'i bstan bcos rnam dag gi mtshan (10bto)da zer na/ rnam g.yeng rgyud ldan gyi byang sems tshogs lam pas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ des brtsams pa'i bstan bcos yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam g.yeng rgyud ldan gyi byang semasatsho gis lam pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig /rnam ma/byen gyis dngos kyi bdag rkyen byas pa la brten nas byung ba'i khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi ngag rnam dag bka'i mtshan nyid zer na/ ljon shing rlung gis bskyod pa las byung ba'i chos kyi sdom bzhi ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs bden pa'i sgo nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ mgrub na/ der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs bden pa'i sgo nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus so/ / kha cig bka' yin na bstan bcos yin pas khyab ste/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ don dam par sangs rgyas kyi gsung nyid bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid du 'thad ces gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/bstan bcos kyi sgra bshad du yod pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ de lta ma yin na bstan bcos kyi sgra bshad du yod na bstan bcos yin pas khyab par thal/ nges pa'i tshig gi tshul gyis na bstan bcos zhes gsungs pa gang zhig /brgyad stong pa lta bu bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'chos stob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan na bstan bcos yin pas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/— 12

phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ (padaganyis pa rang lugs ni/ rang gsungs (11na)pa po sangs rgyas 'phags pas gdul bya'i nyon mongs spong don du gsungs pa'i mthar thug gi gsung rab de bka'i mtshan nyid/ bka' de khyad chos bzhi dang ldan te/ bdag rkyen gyi khyad par rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i ye shes chos sku las byung /brjod bya'i khyad par khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po rdzogs par ston/ phan yon gyi khyad par sgrib gnyis zhi bar byed/ ngo bo'i khyad par sgra skyon mtha' dag dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig don ldan cho ge dang nyer 'brel zhing / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la dbye na gnyen po ston tshul gyi sgo nas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong / yan lag gi sgo nas gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu/ ngo bo'i sgo nas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ byed las kyi sgo nas sde snod gsum/ brjod bya'i sgo nas drang nges kyi mdo gnyis/ ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i sgo nas theg pa che chung gi sde snod gnyis rnams su yod do/ /bslab pa gsum gyi nang nas/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pas rab tu phye ba'i sde snod de 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi mtshan nyid/ mdo sde dang mngon pa gnyis la yang lhag pa ting nge 'dzin dang / lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gnyis gong ltar rigs 'gre byas nas sbyor ro/ /lung sde bzhi dang po'i mtshan gzhi/ las brgya pa gnyis pa dang / mngon pa'i mdo stong phrag brgya pa gsum pa'i 'o/ don dam bden pa dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston zhing / sgra ji bzhin du khas blang du rung ba'i mdo de nges don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid/ drang don gyi mdo'i mtshan (11bsnyad ni kun rdzob bden pa gtso bor dngos su ston zhing dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin du khas blang du mi rung pa'am/ rung yang gnas lugs kyi don de las gong du drangs nas bshad dgos pa gang yang rung ba'i mdo'o/ /rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang po dang / gang zag gi bdag yod par ston pa'i mdo phyi ma'i mtshan gzhi'o/ /gzhan yang zhal nasagasungs pa/ rjes su gnang ba/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' gsum las/ mdo sdud pa dang po dang /sher snying gnyis pa'i mtshan gzhi/ gsum pa la sku gsung thugs gsum las/ mdo sdos bcu pa dang — 13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo6)po dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po gnyis pa'i mtshan gzhi/ gsum pa la/ ting nge 'dzin dang bden pa dang 'phrin las gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pas/ dang po sher snying / gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi bden pa brjod pas ljon shing rlung gis bskyod pa las chos kyi sdom bzhi ston pa'i ngag gsum pa rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyis mi ma yin gyis thol byung du smras pa'i rig sngags lta bu'o/ /khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i bstan bcos su dmigs pa de bstan bcos rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ de ni rang gi bshad byar gyur pa'i bka'i dgongs 'grel yin pa/ rtsom pa po 'jig rten phyogs kyi rnyed bkur grags 'dod kyi rnam g.yeng dang bral ba/ thar pa 'thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa/ sgra skyon mtha' dag dang bral ba'i khyad chos bzhi ldan yin te/ de skad du rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi /che'i/sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na/'khor lo gsum gyi dgongs 'grel las/ dang po la lta ba'i cha gtso bor 'grel ba mngon pa sde bdun/mngon pa gong 'og /spyod pa'i cha gtso bor 'grel pa mdo rtsa lta bu/ gnyis pa la lta ba'i cha la rigasatsho gos drug /(12na〉1da pa'i cha la mngon rtogs rgyan lta bu'o/ /gsum pa la/ lta ba'i cha la 'byed rnam gnyis/ pra ka ra na sdebargyad/ spyod pa'i cha lamado rgyan/ sa sde lnga/ sdom rnam pa gnyis lta bu'o/ /des na/ don med don log don dang ldan/ /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /ga g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong / /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /ces pa las/ sngar bshad pa rnams gsum po'i nang du gtogs la/ drug po ni bya rog so thogs kyi bstan bcos/ 'jog po'i gtsug rgyan len pa'i bstan bcos phyi rol pa'i thos pa tsam dang rtsod pa tsam lhur len pa'i bstan bcos/ bram ze'i gsang tshig ston pa'i bstan bcos/ phyugs kyi mchod sbyin byed pa'i bstan bcos rnams so/ /gong du bshad pa'i bstan bcos rnam dag rnams chos can/ khyod byed las khyad par can dang ldan te/ mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas par byed pa'i phyir/ lha'i bu blo gros rab gsal gyis zhus pa 'a mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'du/ /—/4

phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgro dbyangs las bas dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ 6)legs par bshad dang de yi dgongs 'grel ba/ /de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa ni/ /'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum de bstan bcos chen po'i rnam bshad mdzad ces pa'i skabs kyi bstan bcos yin te/ tshigs gsal las/ nges pa'i tshig gi tshul gyis na bstan bcos te/ de yang khyad par can rgyal ba'i yum rnams so/ /zhes dang / rnam bshad las/ sgra bshad du yod pas bstan bcos chen po mdo'i zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa (12ba)grod pa spong ba ni nyon sgrib spangs pa'i byang sems 'phags pa kho na la gsungs pa'i mdo chos can/ rang lugs kyi mtshan nyid der thal/mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rtags sla/ 'dod mi nus te/ mdo de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul byar gyur pa'i nyen mongs spong dgos kyi sems can med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul byar gyur pa'i theg chen du rigs nges kyi gang zag yod pa gang zhig /de yin na nyon sgrib ma spangs pas khyab pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de theg chen gyi mdo yin pa'i phyir/ de mdo gang zhig /de theg dman gyi mdo ma yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na/ de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul byar gyur pa'i theg dman du rigs nges pa'i theg dman slob pa yod par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/'dod mi nus te/ nyes pa son gnas pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ nyi khri de nyid rnam nges nyi khri kho na'i 'grel pa yin par thal/ ming de ltar du smos pa'i phyir na/ gser 'phreng las/ 'di la nyi khri de nyid rnam nges zhes pa brtag dgos so zhes pa'i don mi 'thad par thal/ khyod kyi khyab pa grub pa'i phyir/ kha cig 'i ri'i bu'i rgyud kyi bka' brgyad stong pa chos can/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i gsung yin par thal/sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi sku yin na/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sku yin pas khyab pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab/ 'o na/ shā ri'i bu'i ngag dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'i gzhi mthun chos can/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i ngag yin par thal/ sangs rgyas kya ngag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus so/ /(13nasgo ba cig shes rab —15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo6)snying po chos can/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' ma yin par thal/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de gnyis mi 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dbyig gnyen gyi man ngag dang ldan tshul ni/ 'gro ba'i don bde legs kyi rtsa lag tu gyur ba'i dbyig gi gnyen chos can/ khyod kyis mdo 'di'i don rnam par dkrol tshul yod de/ rang gi mos pa gtso bor byed pas/ dbu ma las gzhan du gzugs sogs shes bya nang sems kyi bdag nyid yin pa'i lta ba la yang dag par brten nas sems tsam du bkral ba'i phyir/ gsum pa grol sde'i man ngag dang ldan tshul ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam thob pas 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa'i rnam par grol ba'i sde zhes bya ba chos can/ sku mched gnyis gas sngar bkral kyang dbyig gnyen des yum don sems tsam du byas pa de/ don bzhin byas pa min par mthong nas dbu mar gnas pa ltar bkral te don de mkhyen pas blos rnam par phye ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa btsun pa grol sde'i man ngag dang ldan tshul ni/ 'phags pas rnam bshad mdzad pa'i dus de'i 'og tu/ dad pa'i sa tshogos la ma la gnas pa yi btsun pa rnam par grol ba'i sde chos can/ khyod kyis mdo dang bstan bcos kyi tshig don mtha' dag ma rnyed par rang gis gang rnyed dang / rjes mthun du nyi khri dang sbyar ba'i rnam bshad byas pa la rtsom mi rigs pa'i skyon med de/ rang nyid mdo rgyan gyi don la blo gros 'phel ba'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ de ltar sngar gyi mkhas pa bzhis tshig don ci rigs snang bar byas shing / dbyig gnyen sogs 'ga' zhig kho nas ji bzhin (13ba〉pa rnyed pa'i bstan bcos yum gsum mtha' dag 'di snying po'i don mthar thug dang / mngon rtogs brgyad tshang zhing de nyid rgyan gyis 'grel pa de ltar seng ge bzang po bdag gis rnyed pa gang de chos can/ ches ya mtshan te/ phyi rkyen du ma zad nang rkyen bstan bcos kyi don kun rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ mkhas pa dbyig gnyen de lta bus kyang ma rnyed pas shin tu rnyed dka' ba'i zab mo'i lam 'di ci zhig ltar sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs kyi dbang gis rnyed pa ni chos can/ seng bzang dang mtshungs pa'i mkhas pa gzhan rnams — 16

phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang pa'i sgra dbyangs las skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ (pa )kyis kyang dbye bar rigs te/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i mthun rkyen tshang ba'i phyir/gsum pa khengs pa skyung zhing spro ba skyed tshul ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mthu med par rang dbang gis yum don rnam pa kun tu seng bzang bdag gi ni blo'i spyod yul min yang / rnam mkhyen gyi ched du bsod nams dag rgya cher sgrub pa dang rjes mthun gyi thabs 'grel pa 'di chos can/ khyod rtsom pa la spro ba khyad par can skyes pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rang dang theg chen gyi rigs can g.yin la phan gdags par 'dod pa bzhin sgrub nus pa'i phyir/bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa las byams ga myur nga mig da pa/gnyis pa bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa la mchod brjod bshad pa/ rgyas pa la dad pa'i gang zag la phye ste bshad pa/ bsdus don g.yin bstan pa gsum/ dang po la/ mtshams sbyar ba/ rtsa ba/'grel pa'o/ dang po la/ tshig don bshad pa dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa byams pa mgon pos rgyan rtsom pa'i bya ba rim can du ma yod pa'i nang nas/ re zhig dang por mkhyen gsum la phyag 'tshal (14na tha la chos can/ rang don gyi dgos pa yod de/ rang nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par rab tu ston pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ gzhan don gyi dgos pa yod de/rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya g.yin dag yum la rab tu dang ba bskyed pa'i ched du yin pa'i phyir/rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya chos can/ dang ba skyes pa la dgos pa yod de/ dngos su ma bskul kyang don gyis 'jug par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi dang ba skye ba'i yul yod de/bcom ldan 'das ma yon tan rin po che phul dbyung du med cing dpag tu med pa'i sras bzhi'i bzhed don sgrub pa'i 'byung gnas te rgyu de yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ dang ba skye tshul yod de/ gzhi lam rnam — /7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'amakhyen gsum la rim pa bzhin/ nyan rang slob pa nyer zhir 'khrid/ byang 'phags rigs can gsum gyi don sgrub/ sangs 'phags rigs can gsum la chos 'khor bskor ba'i yon tan yod pa ji lta ba bzhin du brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi sgo nas yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ de ltar thos sogs kyis zhugs pa la dgos pa yod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yul du byed pa'i yul can gyi rab tu dang ba'i dad pa ni gnas skabs mthar thug gi legs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin no zhes bya ba tshad ma 'phags pa byams pa'i mnyam gzhag so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyis nges par bzung nas gdul bya gzhan dag kyang dad pa la brten nas byang chub 'thob pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/gnyizla/pa la/ dgag gzhag spang gsum las/ kha cig /sang bas rgyas dbang (14bstanas rnyed pa ni/ zhes dang / bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba zhes pa'i rigs kyi lung la brten nas rje btsun byams mgon sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin zer na/ 'o na/ de ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pa'i don de ma 'ongs pa na 'tshang rgya 'gyur yin pa la byed dam/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston pa la byed/ dang po ltar na/ de chos can/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa ma yin par thal/ 'tshang rgya dgos yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ma 'ongs pa na 'tshang rgya 'gyur yin pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / sems can thams cad sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin par thal lo/ /gnyis pa ltar na/ ston pa shākya thub pa chos can/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin par thal/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ma 'ongs pa na chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ da ltar ba'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mkhas pa kha cig /rnam bshad las/rje btsun mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i dbang du byed na thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i skabs ma phyed pa yin la zhes pa'i lung don/ thun mong ba gdul bya thun mong ba'i ngor sangs rgyas ma — 18

phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgro dbyangs las skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ (pa)yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa dngos po'i gnas tshod la sangs rgyas yin pa'i khyad par 'byed dgos shing / de'i rgyud la rang don don gnyer gyi blo yod do zer na/ rje btsun chos can/ sangs rgyas(15na)yin par thal/ dngos po'i gnas tshod la sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i thugs rgyud la rang don don gnyer gyi blo yod par thal/ rje btsun gyi thugs rgyud la de yod pa ni gang zhig /de gnyis sangs rgyas yin par mtshudas pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud la rang don chos sku don gnyer gyi blo yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud la theg chen gyi thar pa don gnyer gyi blo yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de thar pa don gnyer gyi gang zag yin par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ thar 'dod kyi skyes bu ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig /'dod pa'i rten la gsar du 'tshang rgya ba yod par thal/ dga' ldan gyi rten can gyi rje btsun byams pa gsar du 'tshang rgya dgos kyi gang zag gang zhig /des dga' ldan du bzhugs pa'i mod de nyid la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rje btsun dga' ldan du bzhugasapa'i mod nyid las mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ma bstan pa'i snga rol tu 'og min du 'tshang rgya bar thal/ des dga' ldan du sprul pa zhig bzhag /'og min du chos sku mngon du mdzad nas/ slar yang sprul pa de nyid la zhugs te mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i phyir te/ ji skad du/ phal po che las/byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na 'dug bzhin du chos kyi skur mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /byas pa la kho na re/ dga' ldan gyi rten la gsar du sangs rgyas pa yod par thal/ de'i rten la gsar du sangs rgyas ma thag pa'i gang zag yod pa'i phyir/(15btir thal/ rje btsun gyis dga' ldan du sprul pa zhig bzhag /'og min du chos sku ma wa zhe du mdzad ma thag pa de'i tshe dga' ldan gyi sprul pa des gsar du sangs rgyas ma thag pa'i dga' ldan gyi rten can yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rten can gyi rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na/ bcom ldan 'das gdul bya'i don du ri dwags ru ru'i rnam par bstan pa'i lus de chos can/ ri dwags ru ru'i —/9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo6)lus yin par thal/ de'i rnam pa bstan pa'i lus yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig rje btsun gyi rgyud la rang don chos sku don gnyer gyi blo yod par thal/ de'i rgyud la rang don chos sku la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa yod pa'i phyir zer ba la ni/ 'o na/ de'i rgyud la 'khor ba don gnyer gyi blo yod par thal/ de'i rgyud la 'khor ba la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod mi nus so/ /kha cig /rje btsun sangs rgyas yin par thal/ de sangs rgyas stong po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ma grub na/ der thal/ der gyur pa'i sangs rgyas stong po gang rung yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na/ de nye ba'i sras brgyad gang rung yin par thal/ der gyur pa'i nye ba'i sras brgyad gang rung yod pa'i phyir/khyab pa khas/ rang lugs ni 'grel pa dang ṭī kar sangs rgyas dang bcom ldan 'das sogs su bshad pa ni yum rgyasang 'bring bsdus gsum la bstan bcos kyi sgras bstan pa ltar yin la/ rgyud blar/ skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /zhes sogs dang / rgyud bla'i ṭī skar nges pa'i don du ni ma yin gyi/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa nyid zhes sogs kyang rtsa ba'i de sprul sku spyi'i dbang dang / ṭī ka'i de thun mong ma yin pa'i shan shor ba yin no/ /rnam bshad kyi thun mong ma yin pa ni (16na sngags dang thun mong ba phar phyin theg pa la bya rigs zhing / des na rang lugs la rje btsun byang chub sems dpa' yin te/ gleng gzhi'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / zhes dang / srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi mdo las/ byams pa ni skye ba gcig gis thogs pa ste/ zhes dang /rgyud bla las/ de ltar yid ches lung dang rigasang pa la/ /brten nas bdag nyid 'ba' zhig dag phyir dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams kyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rtsod pa spong ba la/ kha cig /'dod pa'i khams su gsar du 'tshang rgya ba yod par thal/sngags kyi theg pa yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na/ sngags kyi theg pa nasang bshad pa ltar khas ma blang bshapas sngags kyi theg pa med par 'dod dgos par thal/ khyod kyi zhe 'dod 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/grub mtha' 'og ma gsum nas bshad pa ltar khas ma blangs pas grub mtha' 'og ma gsum med par —20

pha ra phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bzhad pa/ (pa)'dod dgos par thal/ mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skabs 'dir grub mtha' 'og ma gsum med par thal/ de nas bshad pa ltar skabs 'dir khas mi len pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ grub mtha' smra ba bzhi med par thal lo/ kha cig /rje btsun sangs rgyas yin par thal/ lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar po sangasargyas yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab bo/ /yum sras sand pa/gnyis pa rtsab la/ tshig don dang / brgal ga gyis gtan la 'bebs pa'o/ /dang po la/ dngosadang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bstod pa dang / phyag 'tshal ba gnyis/ dang po la/ mkhyen gsum gyi yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa dang / 'phags (16ba tha zhi'i yum byed pas bstod pa'o/ /dang po la/ gzhi lam rnam mkhyen gsum las/ dang po ni/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal rang don du 'bras bu sdug kun nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi ba'i 'tshol ba po rnams chos can/ khyod nyer zhir 'khrid pa'i thabs yod de/ chos kun gang zag gi bdag med du shes pa'i gzhi shes gang yin pa de nyid kyis 'khrid pa de nyid kyis sgyud par mdzad pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ 'gro la kun du phan pa sgrub par byed pa'i byang 'phags rnams chos can/ khyod kyis 'bras bu 'jig rten te rigs can gsum gyi don sgrub pa'i thabs yod de/lam gsum bdag med par shes pa'i lam shes gang yin pa nyid kyis 'khrid par mdzad pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ thub pa sangs rgyas rnams chos can/ 'bras bu theg gsum gyi lam rdzogs pa'i brjod bya rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i mdo sde sna tshogs pa 'di gsung ba'i thabs yod de/ shes bya thams cad bdag med du mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gang dang yang dag par ldan pas/ de la brten nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ yum mkhyen gsum chos can/ rang sras 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don sgrub pa'i yon tan dang ldan te/ rang sras nyan thos 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas —2/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo6)pa ste/ rang sras rang rgyal 'phags pa dang rang sras sangs rgyas 'phags pa rnams kyi bzhed don sgrub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rje btsun byams mgon chos can/ khyod kyis rgyan rtsom pa'i thog mar mkhyen gsum la phyag 'tshal ba yin te/ de la 'dud pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ dgag gzhag spang gsum las/ kha cig mchode brjod du mkhyen (17nasgo sum gyi go rim bshad pa 'di mdo'i gleng gzhi'i go rim dang mthun par bstod pa yin zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ 'phags seng gnyis gas mchode brjod gleng gzhi dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa mdzad pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon gyis gleng gzhi'i bshad pa dgos 'brel gyi mjug tu mdzad pa'i phyir/ kha cig nyan thos kyi rigs can theg gsum la rim gyis gzhug pa'i ched du dang por gzhi shes la bstod pa yin zer na/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can yod par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ theg pa thun mong ba'i bstan bcos yin par thal/bstan bcos gang zhig /khyod kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya theg pa mchog dman gyi rigs can gnyis/yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /gdul bya theg pa gsum la rim gyis gzhug pa'i phyir de ltar bstod pa yin zer na yang gong gi des khegs so/ kha cig /lam shes thob pa la gzhi shes thob pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar bstod pa yin zer na/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam chos mchog chen po ba de la gzhi shes yod par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ kha cig /lam shes thob pa la/ skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam gyis bsdus pa'i mi rtag sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes thob pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin zer na/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems sbyor lam pas mi rtag sogs (17ba tshe༅ drug mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ kha cig /skyes bu chen po'i lam rim rgyud la skye ba la/ skyes bu 'bring gi lam la blo sbyong ba sngon du 'gro dgos pa shes pa'i ched du de ltar bstod pa yin zer ba yang mi 'thad de/ 'bring dang thun —22

phar phyin blo bzang dgong rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las bas dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ (pa)mong ba'i lam la blo sbyong dgos kyang / 'bring gi bsam pa de rang nyid gcig pu'i ched du thar pa don gnyer gyi blo la byed dgos pa'i phyir/kha cig /skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i yum yin na/ 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pas khyab zer na/ nyan thos mthong lam pa'i yum chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams zhes sogs kyi tshig rkang dang pos dngos su bstan pa'i yum yod pa'i phyir te/ tshigs rkang dang pos nyan thos mthong lam pa'i yum dngos su bstan pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ nyan thos kyi spyor lam chos mchog chen po'i ye shes de khyod yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum yin na mkhyen gsum gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ mkhyen gsum chos can/ der thal/de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ gzhi shes kyang ma yin/ lam shes kyang ma yin/ rnam mkhyen yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig /dngos po brgyad po mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum yin zer na/ chos sku de yin par thal/ brgyad ka de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/kha cig /skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum yin na skabs 'dir bstan bya'i gtso bor byas nas bstan pa'i yum yin pas khyab zer na/ skabs 'dir (18na te ngos su bstan pa'i mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i theg dman gyi gzhi shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/'dod na/ gnyen po phyogs kyi gzhi shes yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ skabs 'di'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin na/ skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin dgos/ de yin na gnyen po phyogs kyi gzhis shes yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig /mkhyen gsum 'phags bzhi'i yum yin zer na/ mkhyen gsum sang bas rgyas 'phags pa'i yum yin par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de skyed byed yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/de'i snga logs su grub par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/kha cig /'phag ba/pa de'i yum yin na/ 'phag bang pa de'i rgyu yin pabs ma khyab par thal/ rgyal —23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 66)ba'i sras yin na rgyal ba'i 'bras bu yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sangs 'phags kyi rgyur gyur pa'i byang 'phags chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/'o na/ skam las skyes pa'i pad+mo chos can mtsho las skyes par thal/ mtsho skyes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus so/ /kha cig /rang sras 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub nus kyi 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa de skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ rang rgyal gyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ der thal/ 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ shugs la bstan (18ba lnga'i phyir/ kha cig /rang sras 'phags pa skyed pa'i yon tan ldan pa'i cha nas rgyan rtsom pa po'i bstod phyag gi yul du dmigs pa de rgyan gyi mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ ston pa shākya thub pa chos can/mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ mchog gi sprul sku yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus so/ /kha cig /yum yin na mkhyen pa yin pas khyab zer na/ snying rje chen po chos can/ der thal/de'i phyir/ der thal/ tshogs lam skad cig dang po la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i yum yin pa'i phyir/de der thal/ de'i yum yod pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla las/ theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ /sangasargyas chos skyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi/ /bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje'i ma ma can/ /gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras/ /zhes gsung bang pa'i phyir/ kha cig /yum la shes pas khyab zer ba la skyon 'phen pa gzhan dag gis/ yum sgyu ma lha mdzes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i yum yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i yum yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin de shākya thub pa'i sras yin par thal/ sgyu ma lha mdzes de'i yum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang chub sems dpa' yin par thal/ rgyal ba'i sras yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ mchod brjod kyi skabs su dang por gzhi shes/ de nas lam shes/—24

phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las skabs dang po rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ (pa)de nas rnam mkhyen la bstod pa de rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i lam nyams len gyi rim pa dang mthun par bstod pa yin te/ skyes bu 'bring (19na ting thun mong pa'i lam gyi rim pa la blo ma sbyangs par skyes bu chen po'i lam rim gyis bsdus pa'i snying rje chen po mi skye/ de ma skyes na theg chen sems bskyed dang lam shes sogs mi skye bas skyes bu chen po'i lam rim rgyud la skye ba la 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam rim la blo sbyong ba sngon du 'gro dgos pa shes pa'i ched du yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum la skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i mkhyen pa gsum du grangs nges te/ de la de gsum du dbyer yod/ de las mang mi dgos shing nyung na mi 'du ba'i phyir/ sangs 'phags kyi yum de la sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na/ de'i skyed byed kyi yum dang /de'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gnyis las/ phyi ma la/ de skyed byed ma yin pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum dang / skyed byed kyi bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gnyis yod de/ rnam mkhyen dang po dang / sabacu'i ye shes gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i yum yin na/ de'i skyed byed yin pabs khyab pa dang / rnam mkhyen gyi sras(yin na/ de'i 'bras bu yin pas khyab ste/ 'grel pa las sangs rgyas la sogs pa skrun par mdzad pa ni gdon mi za bar srid pa nyid do/ /zhes dang / rnam bshad las/mkhyen pa snga mas 'phags pa phyi ma skyed cing / nyer zhi la sogs pa'i bzhed don sgrub par byed pasayum dang sras ni bskyed bya skyed byed du shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang sras 'phags pa'i bzhed don phun tshogs sgrub byed kyi lam zhugs kyi mkhyen pa de 'dir bstan mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum gyi mtshan nyid/ (19ba〉ngang sras 'phags pa'i bzhed don phun tshogs sgrub byed kyi skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa de skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum gyi mtshan nyid/rtsod pa spong ba la kha cig /mkhyen gsum gang rung yin na/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i mchod brjod du gyur pa'i yum yin pas khyab par thal/ der grangs nges pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'an/ sngar bkag zin/ ma khyab mtshams su/ mngon rjes gang rung yin na tshad ma yin pas khyab pa thal/tshad ma la mngon rjes kyi de gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grig /yang kha cig /rnam mkhyen chos can/ sangs 'phags kyi yum yin par thal/ de'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ yang kho na re/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen gyi tsho gos la ma chos can/ rang srasa'aphags pa'i bzhed don phun sum tshogs sgrub byed kyi lam zhugs kyi mkhyen pa yin par thal/ 'dir bstan mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod kyi sras su gyur pa'i 'phags pa med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ tsho gos sbyor la gnas pa'i dman lam sngon ma song gi 'phagasapa med pa'i phyir zer na/ rang sras 'phags pa'i bzhed don phun tshogs sgrub nus kyi mkhyen pa yin na/'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pas khyab par thal/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam de de ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chen po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags sngar bsgrub zin to/ /kha cig /rnam mkhyen skad cig tha ma chos can/ gong (20na〉she mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi sras su gyur pa'i 'phags pa med pa'i phyir/ der thal/khyod kyi rigs 'dra phyi mar gyur pa'i mkhyen pa med pa'i phyir te/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/ zer na mi 'thad de/ rnam mkhyen skad cig tha ma chos can/ khyod kyi rigs 'dra phyi mar gyur pa'i shes pa yod par thal/ khyod shes pa gang zhig /rang gi rigs 'dra phyi mar mtshams sbyor ba'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ skye ba phyi ma yod pa'i sgrub byed rnam dag med par thal lo/ /gzhan yang /rig pa skad cig dang po chos can/ khyod kyi rigs 'dra snga mar gyur pa'i rig pa med par thal/ khyod rig pa skad cig dang po yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ rig pa skad cig tha ma yin na rang gi rigs 'dra phyi mar gyur pa'i shes pa med dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa brgal lan la/ sa bcad 'ga' zhig gyis kyang / spyi don du rigs pa chags pa rnams kyis shes par bya'o// //—26
