dbang po zha lu lo' gyis mdzad pa la rje drung mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad byang brgyab pa mthong zhing zha dmar bas 'dul ṭika rin 'a phreng ba mdzad byang sbos pa sogs/gas yang de rig kyi gto mang du thos/byang spos pa'i g.yo khram byas pa'ang med//tshad thub bka' dang bstan bcos gang zag la//'di 'dra'i dol po bas lta bar nga la dus gabor myang 'das rgyud bla sogs la khungs lang dang /zha dmar bas 'dul ba thag rgya ma'o khungs 'dren pa ltar/lugs srol yod ces rdzun gyi khag/bkal nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen la//log bshad dkrug pa'i sbyor ba 4 1 med//'ga' 44༷stag mang du thos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo6)pa'i nags klung du/ /glegs bam srin go shāka rje drung mi bskyod rdo rje bya ba sprul sku ngag dbang nor bu sogs/ bu'i me 'od 'degs pa rnams/ /'jam dpal snying yi gtsong kha pa/ po'i gsung gi rta bdun 'od/ khar tshe bris pa'i me ltar gsal rnga blo u stong / /ngang tshul de las phyag rgya chen po sogs/ /sgom sgam 'brug 'bri stag sogs/wo rdzu bag dar gyi rnam 'dra ba/ /rmonges pa'i mig sngar mdzes pa'i zlos gar dag /sgyur rnams zhal gyi sgo de snyun mi mnga'/ /bstan 'dir rjes zhugs kha cig rigs chos rje bsod grags/ pa nyung / /la chos rje rje ga mi pa/ la tshig gi spros par rnam par 'phyan/ kha cig tshig 'khris bstan dar ba phyogs lha ba stobs chos 'byor gas/ gzhung gi dgongs don dor/ /phyogs 'ga' ngag mi nga ba/ 'char brjod min tsam du zad/ /tshig gi lo 'dab kho nas ma bsgribs shing / /'bru 'grel mtha' dpyod snying po'i gang bu can/ /ro brgya'i dpal gyi bsgrun min rnam bshad 'di/ /yongs 'du min yang lha rnams spyod snyam byed/ /sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i lha lam ngos/ /dgongs 'grel chu 'dzin phreng ba h+phu gas pa las/ /dngosabargyad ma 'dres h+phu da pa'i gru char gyis/ /thos bsam dbyar skyes gshone nu cher smin zhing / /lung dang rtogs pa'i gangs kyi ri bo'i spor/ /rnam dpyod gdong lnga'i gzi brjid mngon 'bar ba/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po myong kha ba'i/ /ring lugs dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phyur gyur cig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan ras sa/ /yun du legs par dpyad kyang rnyed dka' bas/ /srid mtsho klung du 'khyams (45na)pa'i mar gyur 'gro/ /dpal ldan sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'thob pa dang / /bzang po'i las dman ma rig stug po'i gos/ /skye bar goms shing tshe 'dir sbyangs stobs zhan/ /bdag lta'i tshogs rnams gtsug lag rgya mtsho la/ /dpyod pa'i shes rab snang ba 'thob par shog /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i stegs/ /phun tsho gis sde bzhi'i 'byor bar dbang bsgrur ba/ /sa spyod dam pa'i khrims kyisanor 'dzin kun/ /dge legs 'dod 'jo'i dbyid du dar gyur cig /ces shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel gsal bar byed pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa 'di yang /—542

phar phyin blo bzang dgong rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs la skabs brgyad pa yis bu'i chos sku bshad pa/ 6)gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi drang nges mtha' dag rigs pa'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i 'dus sde rnams kyi khyu mchog legs bshad chos 'khor gling pa'i slob dpon mdo sngags smra ba'i blo gros kyi rtsal ldan bstan 'dzin 'phrin las dang / chu bzang bla ma rab 'byams pa skal bzang rgya mtsho/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos grags gsum gyis snga phyir nan gyisa'adi lta bu zhig gyis zhes bskul cing / slar yang bka' bcu rab 'byams phal cher gyis mos 'dun yin tshul dang bcas byung bar brten/ dang por 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud dor nas ngur smig bla gos kyis mdzes par byas pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi drung du mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka spyi don thal 'phreng sogasalan kha yar thos pa dang / rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa'i (45bsgom bshad chen mo'i dgongs don rang blos gang spobs go bsdur zhing / chos rje rje btsun pa/ chos rje bsod grags pa/ chos rje sgom sde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs kyi legs par bshad pa rnamasanas kyang kha bskangs te/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir gnam gyis bskos pa'i chos ldan gyi rgyal po gong ma sde srid dpal phag mo gru pa'i mdun na 'don/ 'phags yul pa'i rgyal rigs su la pa chen po za hor gyi rigs las sman ljongs skyid pa'i yul gru yar klungs kyi char skyes shing / rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs la shes nas dad pa thob cing / thub bstan yongs kyi rtsa lag gcig pu mkhan po rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por theg pa che chung gi chos tshul mtha' klas pa'i bka' drin nos la/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid las nges don snying po'i tshul phyogs tsam rig pa/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo slob dpon rin po che dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi zla med pa'i rnam par dpyod pa'i drin gyis/ thun mong ba'i theg pa dang / gtan tshigs rig pa/ bod yul gyi paṇ+ḍita rig gnas rgya mtsho'i phreng ba 'dzin pa sogs mkhas pa du ma'i drin gyis rdo rje'i theg pa dang —543—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonabarda sprod pa ka tsa ṇa sogs tha snyad rig pa'ang mang du thos pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes/ 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge drag po zhes pa lcags spre lor sku bltams nas lo nyis stong drug brgya nyag ma (46na snga 'das pa/ rang lo nyer brgyad du slebasapa/ 'phags yul du so rli ka phyogs 'dir nyi sgrol byed du 'bod cing / rgya nag pa gya shing zhes pa shing pho spre'u'i lo tha skar zla ba'i dbyangs o 'char ba'i tshes la dbu btsugs te/ skabs dang po yan yongasa'adzin mchog gi spyan sngar rtsom phud du phul bas legs so dang bcas te/ lhag ma rnams myur du grub pa dgos zhes bka' stsal ba la brten nas/ sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya'i lo me tog can gyi zla ba phyi ma'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa drang srong zla skyes lha mtshams kyi dga' ma dang rtse ba'i nyin/mkhas grub rgya mtsho 'du ba'i sti gnas dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen por rdzogs par grub pa'i yi ge pa ni rgya bod kyi yi ge'i rigs dang brda dag sogs la blo gros kyi snang ba can ngag dbang dge legs kyis bris pa 'dis kyang bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par mnyam med chorme kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i dngos po lhun gyis grub par gyur cig /oṃ su sti/ 'dzam gling gnas mchoge bya rgod spungs 'dra'i ring / /ston pa'i mgul nas bka' stsal yum gyi mdor/ /gter ltar sbas pa'i mngon rtogs rim pa rnams/ /gsal byed man ngag ma' par rtogs pa'i rgyan/ /mi pham drung nas 'phags mchogo thogs med kyis/ khong du chud par mdzad nas 'dzam gling 'dir/ /rgya che'i man ngag gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshe/ /mdo rgyan dgongs pa 'grel la mkhas rnams brel/ /de tshe mi pham mgon po'i lung bzhin du/ /seng bzang zhabs kyis rgyan don gsal mdzad par/ /mkhas rnams ngo mtshar bskyed de rgya cher spel/ /tshul der rgyal ba gnyis pas dag ther mdzad/ /de ltar blo bzang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i lus/ /ma nor lung rigs rgyan gyis legs spras te/ /skal bzang 'gro la dga' ba'i ston mo sa /stsol mdzad lnga pa che bcas phyag gi yul/ /slar yang rgyan —544

phar phyin blo bzang dgong rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs las bas brgyad pa 'bras bu'i chos sku bshad pa/'dadon 'tshol ba lhur len pa'i//bgrang yas skye rgu'i zhing sa gshin pa la//dgyes pa'i spyan yangs srid zhi'i 'dren mchog nas//deng 'dir chos sbyin mi zad char rgyun dbab//'di'i mthus 'gro ba'i nyesatsho gos dri ma 'khrud//legs byas 'o mtsho bskyil ba'i dbus nyid na//phyag na pad+mo'i mdzad 'phrin 'dab stong ba 'ad//gang gi legs gsung zil mngar rtag spyod shogazhar phyin gzhung lugs kun gsal yangs po'i ngos//bshad sgrub 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis//lus can snying du mtshang bcas ma rig mun//gnas pa'i go skabs 'phrog ste drungs 'byin shog/rnam dag chos srid lugs bzang mthun pa'i rlung //ches cher g.yos pas srid dang dman pa'i mtshor//'phyan rnams theg pa mchog gi sar drangs te//ring min sku gsum gling du 'god /ra cig///shubha ma stu sarba dza ga rta//mas lo////
